sn45.13:1.2: Then a bhikkhu went up to the Buddha … and asked him,
sn45.13:1.3: “Sir, they speak of the one called ‘a trainee’.
sn45.13:2.1: “Bhikkhu, it’s someone who has a trainee’s right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration.
sn45.13:2.2: That’s how a trainee is defined.”
